extraLayerView.scope: Native current inner1 copper including actual BREP pours, registered to the same top-view board coordinates and exact Circuit JSON. This image does not establish that every ground pad shares a plane or manufacture acceptance.

scope: Native top and inner2 geometry. Component reference text suppressed only in presentation; source functional legends retained. All original copper, pads and holes are unchanged. No ratsnest or invented tracks. Pads without visible top-layer tracks may connect on other layers; this rendering does not determine their connectivity or establish clearance/manufacture acceptance.

physicalConnectivity.sourceComponentCountDefinition: Includes bare copper doNotPlace probes; not purchased/fitted BOM quantity.
physicalConnectivity.scope: Counts include routed tracks, actual BREP pour geometry and plated barrels. Point-only contacts are rejected. Unassigned and orphan copper remain defects and are not waived by these counts. This measures physical pad connectivity, not quality, thermal capacity, manufacturing acceptance or engineering completion. Same-net connectivity does not establish absence of foreign-net shorts; the clearance and Gerber auditors must pass separately.

rootRoutingPublicationApproval.scope: Static CAD routing acceptance only; manufacturing, exported masks and hardware bench validation remain separate.

routeProvenance.fullRoutingAcceptanceScope: Static CAD physical routing only. Manufacturing release, bench validation and native solver completion are separate.

renderVerification.visualInspection: PASS: exact current top/inner2 and optional actual inner1 PCB inspected. Minimal 450/450 joined, 0 missing, with scoped routing captions. No future/private copper or fresh native credit. No manufacturing-ready claim.

contextExceptionScope: Historical or proposal context versions whose files changed are explicitly excluded from byte verification and are not substituted into their old hash claims. The actual capture, complete source archive, physical graph and all current scoped gate receipts are preserved at exact hashes. Matching newer context versions may also be copied at their own independently checked hashes.
genericAcceptedFlagScope: The generic accepted=false flag retains whole-board release scope. Exact physical routing completion and existing-copper scoped acceptance are recorded separately; neither grants manufacturing release.
